The route for hotel accommodation or meeting space specifically remains unconfirmed.
decisionProcess.notes: Approach central contracting first, then request referral to the operational unit that handles official commissions, lodging, meetings or training logistics. Do not assume that a procurement director personally chooses hotels.
unknowns: No named person was found with explicit responsibility for hotel sourcing, travel management, transient accommodation or meeting venue contracting.
The contracting authority of the named officials for hotel agreements is not explicitly verified; their organizational relevance is verified, not their personal signing authority.
No preferred-hotel list, negotiated corporate rate, TMC, booking channel or local-office discretion policy was found.
The hotel opportunity record lacks a resolved official property address, brand field and formal hotel demand anchor.
No evidence connects SEFIPLAN's October congress or September training activity to voco Cancún Zona Hotelera.
